title: PostReady: PR #529 — Mobile P1: thumb-zone action bars, preamble compression, loading discipline
description: Implemented Mobile P1 audit improvements: fixed thumb-zone action bars for Create and pack pages on phones, compressed preamble text to desktop-only, and tightened loading discipline across five live mobile screens.

title: PostReady: PR #528 — Seasonal $9/mo save offer in the cancel flow
description: Added a seasonal save offer ($9/mo) in the cancel flow to reduce churn at the cancellation step. Merged Jul 16.

title: PostReady: PR #527 — Weekly token keep-alive cron + honest 'Connection expired' banner
description: Added a weekly cron job to keep OAuth tokens alive so users don't hit silent expiry. Added an honest 'Connection expired' banner when tokens do lapse, replacing silent failure. Merged Jul 16.

title: PostReady: PR #526 — Mobile: uncramped Create tabs + clearer batch type picker
description: Fixed cramped Create tab layout on mobile and improved the batch type picker for clarity. Merged Jul 16.

title: PostReady: PR #525 — Batch as a proper 4th tab on the Create page
description: Elevated Batch to a standalone 4th tab on the Create page (vs the earlier toggle approach of PR #524), giving it full first-class status alongside Single, Pack, and Video. Merged Jul 16.

title: PostReady: PR #524 — Fold Batch into the Create page ('Switch to batch' mode)
description: Merged the standalone Batch page into the Create page with a 'Switch to batch' mode toggle, simplifying navigation and reducing page count. Shipped Jul 16.

title: PostReady: PR #523 — Batch parity: library image picker, add-text toggle, manual-mode default
description: Brought Batch mode to parity with single-post: library image picker, add-text toggle, and manual-mode default. Merged Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #522 — Video source-frame QC: best-of-3 frames judged by vision
description: AI-generated video QC: renders 3 candidate source frames in parallel, uses GPT-4o vision to inspect each for hands/fingers, faces, limbs, and artifacts, then animates the cleanest frame. Merged Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #520 — Landing page: Create · Save · Post section cleanup
description: Cleaned up the landing page Create → Save → Post section for clearer messaging and visual consistency. Merged Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #519 — Video Phase 0+1: single-clip progress, cost + timings, VIDEO_MODEL seam
description: Shipped Video Phase 0+1: single-clip upload progress indicator, cost + timings display, and VIDEO_MODEL seam to abstract the video provider. Merged Jul 15.
